titles.title: Environmental Protection for Children Act of 2006

A bill to amend the Toxic Control Substance Act, the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation, and Liabilitiy Act of 1980, the Emergency Planning and Right-To-Know Act of 1986, and the Federal Hazardous Substances Act, and to authorize the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency to provide grants to States to protect children and other vulnerable sub-populations from exposure to environmental pollutants, and for other purposes.
Environmental Protection for Children Act of 2006
Children's Environmental Protection and Right to Know Act
